classification.difficultyReason: Choose among equal-side algebra, exact Pythagoras, SAS area and cosine-rule angle calculations.

spec.description: Tall centred isosceles triangle with blue outline and matching single blue ticks on its sloping sides. Black labels 6x−7 outside left, 2x+3 outside right, 10cm below the horizontal base. No altitude.
spec.mathematics: Part c retains all numbers; base explicitly rounded. Part b exact-height task is unchanged. Existing square-centimetre answer correction retained.

answer.worked:
The marked sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}6x-7&=2x+3\\4x&=10\\x&=2.5\\s&=2(2.5)+3=8\text{ cm}\\P&=8+8+10\\P&=26\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
The altitude bisects the base into two $5\text{ cm}$ lengths.
$$\begin{align*}h^2+5^2&=14^2\\h^2&=171\\h&=\sqrt{171}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
